name: obs-vertical
description: A vertical (9:16) output for OBS: own canvas and scenes, multi-destination streaming with shared hardware encoders, recording, replay buffer and a 9:16 virtual camera.
long_description: Vertical for OBS adds a portrait canvas with its own scenes next to the main one, a Vertical dock with a live preview, linked scenes, and outputs: several streaming destinations at once (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, RTMP, SRT) sharing hardware encoders, a recording, a replay buffer and a 9:16 virtual camera on macOS. The vertical scene is rendered only while something needs it.
